Frontend Engineer (React) — Design Systems
Company: Swiggy
Location: Bangalore, Hybrid

What you'll do
- Build accessible, responsive user interfaces in React and TypeScript.
- Own and evolve a shared component library used across multiple product teams.
- Collaborate closely with designers in Figma to translate designs into production UI.
- Improve frontend performance, bundle size and Core Web Vitals.
- Write unit tests with Jest and maintain visual regression coverage.

Requirements
- Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals.
- Production experience with React and modern state management such as Redux.
- Solid HTML and CSS skills, including responsive layout and web accessibility.
- Experience consuming REST APIs and handling asynchronous data.
- Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.

Preferred
- Experience with Next.js and server-side rendering.
- Familiarity with Tailwind CSS.
- Interest in design systems and component API design.
